verdict.rationale: Firebase offers Gemini in Firebase, a natural-language chat interface in the console that answers product questions, generates code, and aids troubleshooting/debugging (including Crashlytics AI insights), plus an official MCP server that lets AI editors query/manage Firestore, Auth, and projects—directly matching the ask to write queries, debug, and explain the backend. Hands-on probes confirm the MCP server actually starts and handshakes successfully, corroborating the docs' claims.
